title: odd-rating
description: A score from one to `max` stars (default five), with the chosen value beside the stars ("3 of 5"): the radio-group behavior drawn as stars, each filled up to the chosen one. Without `<option>` children or `options`, the stars are named by `strings.star` ("3 stars"); options name them instead ("Good"), and their count replaces `max`.

name.description: Name submitted with the form. Reflected: a form-associated element submits under its name attribute.

error.description: Error message; marks the field invalid (custom validity) while set.

value.description: Value of the checked option; the `value` attribute sets the default.

required.description: An option must be checked to submit.

max.description: How many stars, when the options are not given.

readonly.description: Shows the value without letting the user change it; still submitted and, as a native read-only field, barred from validation.

strings.description: Localized string overrides: `star` and `starOne` (a star's name, "{count} stars"), `summary` ("{value} of {max}"), `empty` (nothing chosen).
